description: This source file defines an Android ListActivity called List4 that displays a list of speeches using a custom ListAdapter (SpeechListAdapter) and custom view (SpeechView). The list data comes from the Shakespeare class, and each list item displays a title and dialogue.

classes.name: List4
classes.description: Android ListActivity that displays a list of speeches with a custom adapter and view.

classes.name: SpeechListAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to supply data and views for each list item, based on speeches from Shakespeare.

classes.name: SpeechView
classes.description: Custom view extending LinearLayout that displays a speech's title and dialogue using TextViews.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the List4 activity and sets its list adapter to SpeechListAdapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of speech items, based on the length of Shakespeare.TITLES.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as the item, a placeholder since data is from static arrays.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a SpeechView for each list item, populating it with the appropriate title and dialogue.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text in SpeechView.

methods.name: setDialogue
methods.description: Sets the dialogue text in SpeechView.
